entries.text: Someone listening with a screen reader tabs into the footer and hears "link, benefits-x" or just the raw URL three times in a row, with no hint that these are Facebook, X and YouTube. The same three empty icon links sit in the footer of every page — home, apply, sign-in, status — so a keyboard listener hits them on each visit and must either guess or click blind to find out where they land.

Someone with low vision reading the footer sees the "Last updated October 3, 2026" line as pale grey on white at small text size — faint enough to disappear, especially on a dim screen or in sunlight. It repeats in the footer of every page, so an applicant checking whether benefits status information is current cannot tell how fresh what they are reading actually is.
